content: We were similarly influenced by the work of Radford et. al, who argue for the importance of layer normalization and data-specific trained word embeddings for text generation [9] and sentiment analysis categorization. These findings lead us to question whether it is possible to employ recurrent neural networks with long short-term memory gates, as defined by Mikolov et al., to categorize product descriptions into categories based on the product's popularity [6].
